notes: The LQFP-176 escapes are pre-routed: adjacent 0.5 mm pins cannot both leave the pin row on one side with 0.6 mm vias and 0.2 mm clearance (a track passing a neighbouring via at 0.5 mm lateral offset leaves 0.075 mm), so pins alternate inward/outward along each contiguous run; 1V9 pins prefer inward (core island under the body), 3V3 pins outward (background island); the few parity conflicts are closed by In2.Cu corridor zones (notches/fingers) computed from the routed via positions.
Outward escape vias alternate between a near (0.65 mm) and a far (1.9 mm) row so that B.Cu exits of the inward vias pass between them.
In1.Cu is one unbroken GND_CTRL zone (no routing layer); In2.Cu carries only the rail islands and their corridors; signals use F.Cu/B.Cu.
Rail nets reach their islands through the fanout vias; a rail via outside its island is reported and bridged by a corridor zone.
The grid router report is a geometric proposal; only the kicad-cli DRC manifest (schematic parity, severity-all) is verification.
Silkscreen text is placed in part-free areas and its real bounding boxes are checked against the courtyards before saving.

Candidate pre_routed entries (12V_IN 1.0 mm F.Cu bus, 5V_SW/5V_BST hot-loop tracks, eFuse-output via group) and exposed_pad_vias arrays are placed before the fanout; their pads are skipped by the fanout and the auto-placer keeps parts off that copper.
The mezzanine header J8 is on B.Cu (pins toward the power-board socket); through-hole parts block both placement sides.

BIAS_EN (static bias-module enable, DSP pin 12 -> J8 pin 9) is routed as one 0.2 mm track on In2.Cu through the 3V3 background by a single-layer router pass after the F.Cu/B.Cu stages: the band under the DSP south escape rows had no lane for it. The track keeps 0.5 mm from every rail-island polygon and 0.3 mm from vias/plated pads, counts as an obstacle for the corridor zones, and the island fills are rebuilt afterwards; connections the F.Cu/B.Cu stages leave unresolved get the same In2.Cu attempt (reported as fallback; a DSP escape via the outer stages pruned is re-created at the port when it still fits). Every In2.Cu signal track keeps INNER_EDGE_BAND from the island polygons except along its own port exit channel: a track hugging an island edge isolates the background strip in which the corridor notches of that island reach the background (iteration 6, U5.45 3V3).

The rip-up negotiation runs with the penalty ladder 1x / 0.4x / 2.5x of the plan ripup_penalty (LadderRouter in this generator; the shared grid_router tries one penalty per failing connection since 2026-10-11): without the ladder the control board stops at 2 unconnected (RDY_H, PG_BIAS_L_N).
